subject: Request: Consolidated personnel archive for SOC 2 snapshot
messages:
From: Eleanor Reed <audits@atlasassurance.com>

Cc: Jordan Black <security@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 - consolidated personnel evidence for onboarding/offboarding and training

Hi Grace / Karthik,

As part of the SOC 2 readiness snapshot for Acme Financial (scope Q1 2026), Atlas needs a single package containing the following artifacts for a sample set of employees: 

- Training completion records (last 12 months)
- Evidence of background checks (redacted PII OK)
- Onboarding access matrix and most-recent deprovisioning logs
- HR attestation for policy acknowledgement

Can you confirm:
1) Whether you can provide a single zipped package with these items or point us to a secure Drive folder?
2) A target delivery date (we're aiming for 2026-01-22 for initial review).

If you prefer, we can accept separate files, but a consolidated index file that maps employee IDs to documents will make our audit faster.

Thanks,
Eleanor Reed
Senior Auditor | Atlas Assurance
